name: Lightsaber Battlegrounds
desc:
TRY OUT NEW GAME: https://www.roblox.com/games/100968655856602/Saber-Battles

V 1.1.0 Fight solo or in teams, hone your lightsaber skills and use your force powers to rule the Lightsaber Battlegrounds.

Controls:
    LMB = Swing (Lightsaber)
    RMB = Block (Lightsaber)
    R = Throw (Lightsaber)
    Q = Taunt (Lightsaber)
    T = Ignite (Lightsaber)
    F = Use (Force Power)
    X = Switch (Force Power)

Thanks to CaptainRojon for the amazing thumbnail.
